loadtest.label: Load test
loadtest.description: Stepped TPS load test, 2026-09-28 23:22-23:33 UTC+8: 39,377 EIP-1559 self-transfers of 1 wei (21,000 gas) from the shard0 faucet to itself. Fees (~0.0085 SCDO) went to our own miner; no funds were created. Hidden from default transaction lists; still indexed and queryable.
